# Security

## Please note

Before reporting a vulnerability, make sure it is in scope. For example you should report:

- Server issues that may escalate privileges or expose user data.
- Client issues that allow remote code execution or expose user data.

You should not report anything that requires physical access to someone else's device, such as:

- Tricks that only change what the UI looks like without changing actual server privileges
- Credential theft that depends on a third-party site the user was already tricked into using

Do not include exploit payloads, malware, or attack scripts in reports.

## Disclosure

You may disclose security issues in two ways:

- Open a draft [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/klovy-chat/backend/security/advisories/new) on the affected repository ([backend](https://github.com/klovy-chat/backend), [frontend](https://github.com/klovy-chat/frontend), [website](https://github.com/klovy-chat/website), or [application](https://github.com/klovy-chat/application)).
- Email [kontakt@klovy.systems](mailto:kontakt@klovy.systems)

Please include:

- The type of issue
- Which project(s) are affected
- Steps to reproduce (without a working exploit)
- Any relevant source files, if you know them
- Version information (commit hash, app version, etc.)

Thank you for helping Klovy Chat.
